PAGE_DESCRIPTION: See what needs action, which areas are ready, and what recovered. Last checked {{date}}.
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Platform status is not available right now. We won't guess a status from older or incomplete data.
PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: Available information is still shown, but missing sections are not treated as healthy.
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The latest status from {{source}} can't be confirmed right now. Other information is still available.
NEEDS_ATTENTION_DESCRIPTION: Issues that need an operator decision or action now.
NO_ATTENTION: Nothing needs attention right now. Monitoring continues.
DOMAIN_POSTURE_DESCRIPTION: See whether each enabled area is available, set up, and healthy.
NO_DOMAINS: There are no management pages available to this account right now.
RECENT_RECOVERIES_DESCRIPTION: Issues confirmed as recovered by the responsible service.
NO_RECENT_RECOVERIES: No confirmed recoveries appear in these results.
READY_AREAS_DESCRIPTION: {{ready}} of {{total}} available areas are set up and ready to use.
ROLLOUT_DESCRIPTION: Control which Workspaces this capability serves; preview the impact first, then confirm.
ROLLOUT_NO_WORKSPACES: There are no Workspaces to select.
ROLLOUT_EXPIRES_AT: Preview valid until {{time}}; regenerate it after that.
ROLLOUT_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for this change.
ROLLOUT_APPLIED_DESCRIPTION: Effective now (policy revision {{revision}}); Workspace availability follows immediately.
ROLLOUT_FAILED: The action could not be completed.
